slides.headline: She became the first Indian-origin, first woman of color to lead a 131-office global ad network.
Devika Bulchandani
slides.body: After 26 years at McCann, Bulchandani was named Global CEO of Ogilvy in September 2022 - the storied British-founded advertising network with offices in 93 countries.

slides.headline: No Indian-origin leader, and no woman of color, had run Ogilvy before.
slides.body: Ogilvy's global network spans 131 offices worldwide. Bulchandani's appointment made her both the first Indian-origin CEO and the first woman of color to hold the role in the agency's history.

slides.eyebrow: Why it matters for Viksit Bharat 2047
slides.headline: The industries keep expanding.
slides.body: Indian-origin leadership at the top of global business used to cluster in tech and finance. Advertising, media, and culture-facing industries are now part of the same story - each new first widens where the next one can happen.
